sentences.l1: There are many tall buildings in cities.

sentences.l2: 一些高楼的墙上种了植物。
sentences.l1: Plants have been planted on the walls of some tall buildings.

sentences.l2: 这些植物可以长出蔬菜。
人们在楼里种菜，不用去很远的地方买。
sentences.l1: People grow vegetables in the buildings, so they don't need to go far away to buy them.

sentences.l2: 这样，大家有更多新鲜的蔬菜吃。
sentences.l1: This way, everyone has more fresh vegetables to eat.

sentences.l2: 这可以帮助解决粮食安全问题。
sentences.l1: This can help solve the problem of food security.
The places where vegetables are grown also look very nice.

sentences.l2: 有绿色植物的地方，空气更干净。
sentences.l1: In places with green plants, the air is cleaner.

sentences.l2: 住在附近的人感觉更舒服。
sentences.l1: People living nearby feel more comfortable.
In comfortable places, houses are more expensive.

sentences.l2: 有植物的楼，房地产价值更高。
sentences.l1: Buildings with plants have higher real estate value.

sentences.l2: 政府和公司愿意投资这种地方。
sentences.l1: Governments and companies are willing to invest in this kind of place.

sentences.l2: 种菜的楼需要好好设计。
sentences.l1: Buildings that grow vegetables need to be designed well.

sentences.l2: 这是城市规划的一部分。
sentences.l1: This is part of urban planning.
Doing this well is good for the future.
